label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Dear Larkspur Lofts Residents,

I’m writing about the drone I flew from the roof deck on Saturday, October 31, at around 4:00 p.m. I live in unit 5A and have been a resident here for three years.

I’m a wedding photographer, and I was testing a new Halvard Mini 4 drone ahead of a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The flight lasted about 11 minutes. Throughout the flight, the camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge, not at anyone’s windows.

I understand why seeing a drone hovering and buzzing near the courtyard would be unsettling, especially without knowing what it was doing. A neighbor mentioned that her grandchildren were frightened by it. I’m sorry that my flight caused worry, and I should have considered how it might look and sound to others in the building.

I also want to address the note posted in the lobby. Being called a “creep” and having my unit number displayed publicly was upsetting. I understand that people may have had genuine concerns, but I would appreciate the opportunity to address them directly rather than through a public note.

For anyone who would like to see what the drone recorded, I’m happy to show you the full, unedited footage. Please feel free to knock on my door at 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

I haven’t found anything in the current HOA rules that addresses drones. Even so, I won’t fly from the roof again until the board has decided on a rule. I’ll ask the board to add the subject to the agenda for its meeting on November 19 at 7:00 p.m. in the community room.

If you have concerns or questions in the future, please come talk to me directly. I want everyone to feel comfortable in our building, and I appreciate the chance to clear this up.

Sincerely,  
Jess Okafor  
Unit 5A
